description: This file defines the LangUtils class which provides utility functions for language-related features within the application, integrating with the Lang class and Symfony's Request.

classes.name: LangUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing language-related functions, integrating with the Lang class and handling the request context.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Retrieves the current request object, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: provideFilters
methods.description: Provides an empty array of filters.

methods.name: provideFunctions
methods.description: Returns an array of registered functions for language utilities.

methods.name: lang_current
methods.description: Returns the current language, optionally public-only.

methods.name: lang_short
methods.description: Returns the short code of a language.

methods.name: lang_name
methods.description: Returns the full name of a language.

methods.name: list_countries
methods.description: Lists countries, optionally in a specified language.

methods.name: lang_list
methods.description: Provides a list of all languages with specified type and scope.

methods.name: lang_active
methods.description: Checks if a language is active.

methods.name: lang_url
methods.description: Generates a URL for a given language, considering current request.

methods.name: lang_url_query
methods.description: Generates a URL with language query, considering current request.

methods.name: lang_host
methods.description: Returns the hostname for a given language.
